title: Section 1
context: A tourist is phoning a rental shop to hire a bike for a trip around the coast.

audio.t: You will hear a man phoning a rental shop about hiring a bike for a holiday.
Good morning, Seaview Cycle Hire. How can I help you?
Hi there. I'm visiting the area next month and I'd like to hire a bike for a few days.
Of course. Let me take some details. Could I have your surname, please?
It's Whitcomb.
Sorry, was that W-I-T-C-O-M-B?
Not quite. It's W-H-I-T-C-O-M-B-E, with an H after the W and an E on the end.
Got it, Whitcombe. And when would you like to pick the bike up?
I arrive on the 13th of June, so let's say the 13th.
Right, the 13th.
Oh, hang on. My ferry gets in very late that night, so I won't be able to come to the shop until the next morning. Make it the 14th, please.
No problem, the 14th of June. What kind of bike are you after? We have mountain bikes, city bikes and electric bikes.
I was thinking of a mountain bike, because I like riding off-road.
Well, I should warn you that the coastal route is very hilly, and most of it is on paved roads.
Ah, in that case an electric bike would be much better. I'll go for that.
Good choice. How many days will you need it?
Four days, I think. Actually, I'd like to include the Friday for the island trip, so that makes it five.
Five days, fine. Now, the price. City bikes are 12 pounds a day and mountain bikes are 15.
And the electric ones?
Those are 18 pounds a day, but the price drops if you hire for a full week.
That's all right. Five days is what I need.
We also take a refundable deposit. It's 30 pounds for ordinary bikes, but for the electric ones it's 40.
Fine. Do I pay that when I collect the bike?
Yes, and you'll need to bring some identification. Most people think a driving licence is enough.
I do have my licence with me.
That's only needed for scooters, I'm afraid. For bicycles we need to see your passport.
Okay, I'll make sure I have my passport in my hand luggage.
Great. Our shop is on Hill Street, just opposite the bus station.
Sorry, did you say Hill Street?
No, Mill Street. That's M-I-L-L, next to the old bakery.
Thanks. Is it possible to add any extra equipment? I'll be carrying a lot of luggage.
We can fit a rear rack, but you'd need to bring your own bags. A front basket is also free of charge.
Then I'll just take the basket. A rack would make the bike too heavy to push uphill if the battery runs out.
Fair enough. Finally, can I take a contact number in case the bike isn't ready?
That's 07731, 508, 246. Perfect, Mr Whitcombe. We'll see you on the 14th.
Thanks very much. Goodbye.

questions.explain: Người gọi đánh vần "W-H-I-T-C-O-M-B-E, with an H after the W and an E on the end"; nhân viên ban đầu nghe sai (Whitcomb) nên bẫy nằm ở chữ E cuối.
Ban đầu ông nói ngày 13, rồi đổi: "Make it the 14th, please" vì phà đến muộn.
Ông định thuê xe leo núi nhưng nghe tuyến đường nhiều dốc, nên chốt: "an electric bike would be much better. I'll go for that."
Ông nói bốn ngày rồi sửa: "to include the Friday ... that makes it five."
Xe đạp thành phố 12, xe leo núi 15, còn xe điện (loại ông chọn) là "18 pounds a day".
"30 pounds for ordinary bikes, but for the electric ones it's 40" - ông thuê xe điện nên là 40.

questions.q: Must bring your ______ when collecting the bike
questions.explain: Bằng lái chỉ cần cho xe tay ga: "For bicycles we need to see your passport."

questions.q: Shop address: ______ Street, opposite the bus station
questions.explain: Ông nghe nhầm là Hill Street, nhân viên sửa: "No, Mill Street. That's M-I-L-L".
Ông từ chối giá hành lý phía sau và chọn: "I'll just take the basket."
Ông đọc số điện thoại: "It's 07731 508 246", nhân viên đọc lại để xác nhận.
